source: Original user-supplied XLSX data definition tab

fields.name: applicant_id
fields.definition: Unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to each loan application in the inbound queue.

fields.name: application_date
fields.definition: Calendar date on which the application was submitted (YYYY-MM-DD), spanning April 1, 2026 to June 30, 2026.

fields.name: customer_profile
fields.definition: Applicant demographic and employment classification segment.

fields.name: has_formal_cic_history
fields.definition: Binary flag indicating presence of historical records at the national Credit Information Center (1 = Yes, 0 = No).

fields.name: has_observable_tx
fields.definition: Binary flag indicating whether pre-application transaction or banking account records are observable for the applicant (1 = Yes, 0 = No).

fields.name: monthly_inflow_vnd
fields.definition: Average monthly cash inflow recorded across observable accounts or partner platforms, denominated in VND.

fields.name: inflow_cv
fields.definition: Coefficient of variation of monthly cash inflows (ratio of standard deviation to mean inflow), measuring cash-flow dispersion.

fields.name: unified_credit_score
fields.definition: Numerical credit rating assigned to the applicant on a standardized scale from 350 to 850.

fields.name: casa_balance_vnd
fields.definition: Average 90-day balance maintained in Current and Savings Accounts (CASA) at the bank, denominated in VND.

fields.name: dti_ratio
fields.definition: Debt-to-Income ratio, defined as total estimated monthly debt obligations divided by monthly cash inflow.

fields.name: on_time_bill_ratio
fields.definition: Ratio of scheduled utility, telecommunication, and recurring invoices settled on or before the due date (0.0 to 1.0).

fields.name: e_wallet_topups_pm
fields.definition: Average count of digital wallet top-up transactions completed per month.

fields.name: regular_weekly_pattern
fields.definition: Binary flag indicating whether recurring weekly transfer or transaction cycles are detected (1 = Yes, 0 = No).

fields.name: rapid_drain_flag
fields.definition: Indicator flag for account depletion or complete fund withdrawal occurring shortly following a top-up (1 = Yes, 0 = No).

fields.name: requested_loan_vnd
fields.definition: Financing facility amount requested by the applicant at point of checkout, denominated in VND.

fields.name: approved_loan_vnd
fields.definition: Total credit facility amount approved for disbursement in VND (recorded as 0 if not approved).

fields.name: loan_tenure_months
fields.definition: Repayment duration of the requested loan facility, in months.

fields.name: interest_rate_pct
fields.definition: Annualized nominal interest rate assigned to the financing facility (% per annum).

fields.name: is_default_90d
fields.definition: Binary repayment outcome indicating whether the borrower incurred 90 or more days past due during the loan tenure (1 = Yes, 0 = No).

fields.name: manual_approval_status
fields.definition: Application underwriting decision under the standard review process (1 = Approved, 0 = Declined).

fields.name: manual_decision_days
fields.definition: Turnaround time from application receipt to final decision under the standard review process, in business days.

fields.name: manual_review_cost_vnd
fields.definition: Standard operational underwriting and verification cost incurred per application under manual review.

fields.name: is_abandoned
fields.definition: Binary flag indicating whether the applicant exited the onboarding process before final decisioning (1 = Abandoned, 0 = Completed).

fields.name: stp_approval_status
fields.definition: Underwriting decision generated by the automated Straight-Through Processing framework (1 = Approved, 0 = Declined).

fields.name: stp_decision_minutes
fields.definition: Turnaround time from application submission to automated decision delivery under the STP framework, in minutes.

fields.name: stp_review_cost_vnd
fields.definition: Estimated system execution and data query cost incurred per application under the automated STP process.
